title: iOS Simulator MCP benchmark: nine tools for AI agents
summary: NoMac compares tool latency, estimated response tokens, and app-confirmed actions across nine Simulator integrations on one sign-in flow. An iOS team can reproduce the calls against its own fixtures, count failed taps despite success responses, and measure setup separately; the report uses fixed tool calls on one virtual Mac and estimates tokens rather than measuring model usage.
takeaway: Verify actions with app-side evidence; benchmark Device Hub open and closed, and report failed attempts, setup costs, and estimated-token assumptions alongside latency.
